item.title: Extratropical cyclone leaves 1 dead and over 2 million without power in eastern Brazil
item.description: At least one person was reported dead as a powerful extratropical cyclone brought winds of over 100 km/h (62 mph) to parts of eastern Brazil on Wednesday, December 10, 2025. The storm's impact left over 2 million customers out of power by Thursday morning, December 11, including 1.5 million in São Paulo alone. Source

item.title: Propane shortages during cold outbreak trigger state of emergency in New Jersey, U.S.
item.description: New Jersey Governor Phil Murphy declared a state of emergency effective at 09:00 LT (14:00 UTC) on December 12, 2025, due to propane supply shortages affecting residential heating across the state. The declaration applies to approximately 186 000 residents who rely on propane-based heating systems. Source

item.title: After historic flooding in Washington, a new atmospheric river is forecast to impact the U.S. West Coast
item.description: Historic flooding caused by a major atmospheric river earlier this week impacted large parts of western Washington state, prompting evacuations, emergency declarations, and record river levels. As impacts from that event persist, another strong atmospheric river is forecast to reach the Pacific Northwest on Sunday, December 14, 2025, bringing a prolonged period of precipitation to Washington, Oregon, and northern California through mid-week. Source

item.title: Flash floods in Iraq leave 3 dead, damage over 2 600 homes
item.description: Deadly flash floods on December 9, 2025, killed at least three people in Iraq's Kurdistan and Kirkuk region, damaging over 2 600 homes and structures in the affected regions. Source

item.title: Leavenworth Christmastown festival cancelled as historic flooding and power disruptions hit Washington, U.S.
item.description: The Leavenworth Christmastown festival was cancelled after historic Washington floods triggered widespread power outages across Chelan County. Over 5 000 customers across the county, accounting for more than 11 000 people, were left without power due to the impacts of a major atmospheric river (AR). Power is expected to be restored for most customers by the evening of December 13, 2025, while debris cleanup and recovery efforts are expected to continue until next weekend. Source

item.title: Record rainfall brings ancient Lake Manly back to life in Death Valley
item.description: Record-breaking rainfall in Death Valley, California, has brought the ancient lake to life, according to satellite images issued by NASA on December 12, 2025. Source

item.title: Geminid meteor shower peaks tonight, December 13
item.description: The Geminid meteor shower will peak on the night of December 13, 2025, with over 150 meteors per hour being visible during peak hours. Source

item.title: Lake-effect snow warnings in effect for parts of New York, Pennsylvania, and Ohio
item.description: Lake effect snow warnings are in effect for parts of New York, Pennsylvania, and Ohio through Sunday into Monday, December 14 into 15, 2025 as Arctic air driven by the polar vortex brings cold temperatures across the eastern U.S. Source

item.title: Atmospheric rivers to continue affecting Pacific states through late December amid La Niña pattern
item.description: A series of atmospheric rivers are forecast to continue impacting the Pacific Northwest and spread southward into California through late December. Moderate risks of heavy precipitation, snow, and high winds are forecast across the West Coast between December 20 and 26, 2025. Source

item.title: Extreme cold warnings in effect across parts of Indiana, Illinois, and West Virginia
item.description: Arctic air driven by the polar vortex has prompted extreme cold warnings across parts of Indiana, Illinois, and West Virginia on December 14, 2025. Wind chills between −21°C (−6°F) and −30°C (−22°F) are producing dangerous conditions capable of causing frostbite on exposed skin within 30 minutes. Source
